pairs: Ego vir videns paupertatem meam in virga indignationis ejus.
ALEPH. I am a man watching my own poverty by the rod of his indignation.
He has driven me and led me into darkness,
Tantum in me vertit et convertit manum suam tota die.
ALEPH. Against me only, he has turned and turned again his hand, all day long.
Vetustam fecit pellem meam et carnem meam;
BETH. My skin and my flesh, he has made old;
He has built all around me,
and he has encircled me with gall and hardship.
BETH. He has gathered me into darkness,
like those who are forever dead.
GHIMEL. He has built against me all around,
so that I may not depart.
He has increased the burden of my confinement.
Yet even when I cry out and beg,
GHIMEL. He has enclosed my ways with square stones;
DALETH. He has become to me like a bear lying in ambush,
DALETH. He has subverted my paths,
He has placed me in desolation.
DALETH. He has bent his bow,
et posuit me quasi signum ad sagittam.
and he has positioned me like a target for his arrows.
Misit in renibus meis filias pharetræ suæ.
HE. He has shot into my kidneys the daughters of his quiver.
Factus sum in derisum omni populo meo,
HE. I have become a derision to all my people,
HE. He has filled me with bitterness;
he has inebriated me with wormwood.
Et fregit ad numerum dentes meos;
VAU. And he has broken each one of my teeth;
he has fed me with ashes.
Et repulsa est a pace anima mea;
VAU. And my soul has been driven away from peace;
I have forgotten what is good.
“My end and my hope from the Lord has perished.”
Remember my poverty and my transgression,
ZAIN. I will call to mind the past,
et tabescet in me anima mea.
and my soul shall languish within me.
ZAIN. These recollections are in my heart;
HETH. By the mercies of the Lord,
For his compassion has not passed away.
HETH. I know it at first light;
Because of this, I will wait for him.
Bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum,
TETH. The Lord is good to those who hope in him,
to the soul that seeks him.
Bonum est præstolari cum silentio salutare Dei.
TETH. It is good to stand ready in silence for the salvation of God.
Bonum est viro cum portaverit jugum ab adolescentia sua.
TETH. It is good for a man, when he has carried the yoke from his youth.
He shall sit solitary and silent.
For he has lifted it upon himself.
JOD. He shall place his mouth in the dirt,
if perhaps there may be hope.
JOD. He shall give his cheek to those who strike him;
he shall be saturated with reproaches.
Quia non repellet in sempiternum Dominus.
CAPH. For the Lord will not rebuke forever.
Quia si abjecit, et miserebitur, secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum.
CAPH. For, if he has cast down, he will also have compassion, according to the multitude of his mercies.
Non enim humiliavit ex corde suo et abjecit filios hominum.
CAPH. For he has not humiliated from his heart, nor has he thrown aside the sons of men,
Ut conteret sub pedibus suis omnes vinctos terræ.
LAMED. as if to crush under his feet all the prisoners of the land,
Ut declinaret judicium viri in conspectu vultus Altissimi.
LAMED. as if to turn aside the judgment of a man in the sight of the presence of the Most High,
Ut perverteret hominem in judicio suo;
LAMED. as if to pervert a man in his judgment:
the Lord does not do this.
Quis est iste qui dixit ut fieret, Domino non jubente?
MEM. Who is this, who said to do what the Lord did not command?
Ex ore Altissimi non egredientur nec mala nec bona?
MEM. Does not both misfortune and good proceed from the mouth of the Most High?
MEM. Why has a living man murmured,
a man suffering for his sins?
NUN. Let us examine our ways,
Levemus corda nostra cum manibus ad Dominum in cælos.
NUN. Let us lift up our hearts, with our hands, toward the Lord in the heavens.
and we have provoked to wrath.
SAMECH. You have covered us in your fury,
SAMECH. You have set a cloud opposite you,
Eradicationem et abjectionem posuisti me in medio populorum.
SAMECH. In the midst of the peoples, you have uprooted me and cast me out.
Aperuerunt super nos os suum omnes inimici.
PHE. All our enemies have opened their mouths over us.
Formido et laqueus facta est nobis vaticinatio,
PHE. Prediction has become for us a dread, and a snare,
My eye has brought forth streams of water at the contrition of the daughter of my people.
AIN. My eye has been afflicted,
nec tacuit, eo quod non esset requies.
and it has not been quieted, because there would be no rest
until the Lord looked down and saw from the heavens.
Oculus meus deprædatus est animam meam in cunctis filiabus urbis meæ.
AIN. My eye has exhausted my soul over every one of the daughters of my city.
Venatione ceperunt me quasi avem inimici mei gratis.
SADE. My enemies have chased me, and they have caught me like a bird, without reason.
Lapsa est in lacum vita mea,
SADE. My life has fallen into a pit,
and they have placed a stone over me.
SADE. The waters have flooded over my head.
COPH. I called upon your name,
ne avertas aurem tuam a singultu meo
Do not turn away your ear from my sobbing and my cries.
Appropinquasti in die quando invocavi te;
COPH. You drew near in the daytime, when I called upon you.
O Lord, the case of my soul.
You are the Redeemer of my life.
O Lord, their iniquity against me.
RES. You have seen all their fury,
every one of their thoughts is against me.
SIN. You have heard their reproach,
O Lord, all their thoughts are against me.
SIN. The lips of those who rise up against me,
et meditationes eorum adversum me tota die.
and their meditations, are against me all day long.
Watch their sitting down and their rising up:
THAU. You shall pay a recompense to them,
O Lord, according to the works of their hands.
THAU. You shall give them a heavy shield of the heart:
THAU. You shall pursue them in fury,
et conteres eos sub cælis, Domine.
and you shall destroy them under the heavens, O Lord.
